art_prompt: Bold vector baseball illustration, distressed stitched texture, catcher's mitt and ball centered, blank circular photo cutout frame above for a player photo, varsity stripe accents on sides, retro screen-print shading, colors white, red, navy, mustard, customizable stripe for team color, text arched above graphic and stacked below the number area
title: Personalized Player Shirt, Custom Name Number Softball Baseball Tee, Retro Team Style, Youth Sports Gift
description:
Built for the kid who lives for the diamond every weekend. This retro-inspired design features a custom photo frame, name, number, and your team's exact colors for a shirt that feels personal, not generic.

Perfect for tournament merch tables, team gifts, or a proud parent's new favorite tee. The distressed print style gives it that broken-in, vintage look right out of the bag.

Easy to personalize, quick to order, and priced right for buying a fresh one every season. Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
risk_notes: Original generic sports graphic with no real team or league references.

flags.msg: Illustrations didn't pass the Art Director, so this uses a typography layout instead.
